```
/**
 * @file    Config.h
 * @brief   Global compile-time configuration — single source of truth.
 *
 * All module-specific tuning constants live here, organised in sections.
 * Include this file directly; do NOT include individual module headers here.
 */

#ifndef CONFIG_H
#define CONFIG_H

#ifdef __cplusplus
extern "C" {
#endif


/* ============================================================================
 * BUILD MODE  (uncomment exactly one)
 * ============================================================================
 *  RELEASE          Full safety, dual APPS sensors, all checks active.
 *  TEST_SINGLE_ADC  One APPS sensor only; plausibility checks disabled.
 *  TEST_FULL        Dual APPS sensor, relaxed plausibility for bench use.
 * ========================================================================== */
// #define BUILD_RELEASE
#define BUILD_TEST_SINGLE_ADC
// #define BUILD_TEST_FULL

#if !defined(BUILD_RELEASE) && !defined(BUILD_TEST_SINGLE_ADC) && !defined(BUILD_TEST_FULL)
    #error "Config.h: select a build mode."
#endif

#if (defined(BUILD_RELEASE) + defined(BUILD_TEST_SINGLE_ADC) + defined(BUILD_TEST_FULL)) > 1
    #error "Config.h: only one build mode may be active."
#endif


/* ============================================================================
 * ADC — DMA channel layout  (must match CubeMX scan rank order)
 * ============================================================================
 *  Rank 1 : PB14 / ADC1_IN5  → SAS
 *  Rank 2 : PB12 / ADC1_IN11 → APPS2
 *  Rank 3 : PB1  / ADC1_IN12 → Brake Sensor
 *  Rank 4 : PB11 / ADC1_IN14 → APPS1
 * ========================================================================== */
#define ADC_NUM_CHANNELS        4U

#define ADC_CH_SAS              0U
#define ADC_CH_APPS2            1U
#define ADC_CH_BSENSOR          2U
#define ADC_CH_APPS1            3U


/* ============================================================================
 * APPS — Accelerator Pedal Position Sensor
 * ============================================================================ */

#if defined(BUILD_TEST_SINGLE_ADC)
    #define APPS_NUM_SENSORS                1U
    #define APPS_DISABLE_MISMATCH_CHECK         /* single sensor: no cross-check */
    #define APPS_DISABLE_RANGE_CHECK
    #define APPS_DISABLE_DEADZONE
#else
    #define APPS_NUM_SENSORS                2U
#endif

/* Filter windows */
#define APPS_MEDIAN_WINDOW                  19U     /* keep odd */
#define APPS_FILTER_WINDOW                  45U

/* Deadzone and plausibility (FSAE T11.8) */
#define APPS_DEADZONE_PERCENT               30U
#define APPS_IMPLAUSIBILITY_THRESHOLD_PCT   10U     /* max allowed delta between sensors */
#define APPS_IMPLAUSIBILITY_TIMEOUT_MS      100U
#define APPS_OUT_OF_RANGE_MARGIN_ADC        100U
#define APPS_OUT_OF_RANGE_TIMEOUT_MS        100U
#define APPS_RESET_THRESHOLD_PERCENT        10U     /* pedal must be below this to clear error */

/* ADC calibration  (measured at vehicle, replace defaults before race!) */
#if defined(BUILD_TEST_SINGLE_ADC)
    #define APPS1_ADC_MIN                   0U
    #define APPS1_ADC_MAX                   4095U
    #define APPS2_ADC_MIN                   0U
    #define APPS2_ADC_MAX                   4095U
#else
    #define APPS1_ADC_MIN                   400U
    #define APPS1_ADC_MAX                   3200U
    #define APPS2_ADC_MIN                   300U
    #define APPS2_ADC_MAX                   2800U
#endif


/* ============================================================================
 * BRAKE SENSOR — hydraulic pressure (single analog sensor)
 * ============================================================================ */

#define BSENSOR_MEDIAN_WINDOW               11U     /* keep odd */
#define BSENSOR_FILTER_WINDOW               20U

#define BSENSOR_ADC_MIN                     200U    /* ADC at 0 bar (replace after calibration) */
#define BSENSOR_ADC_MAX                     3800U   /* ADC at full pressure */
#define BSENSOR_OUT_OF_RANGE_MARGIN_ADC     150U
#define BSENSOR_OUT_OF_RANGE_TIMEOUT_MS     100U

/* Brake-light threshold: turn on brake light above this pressure [%] */
#define BSENSOR_BRAKE_LIGHT_THRESHOLD_PCT   5U


/* ============================================================================
 * SAS — Steering Angle Sensor
 * ============================================================================ */

#define SAS_MEDIAN_WINDOW                   11U     /* keep odd */
#define SAS_FILTER_WINDOW                   40U
#define SAS_DEADZONE_DEGREES                1U      /* snap to 0 near centre */

/* ADC calibration */
#define SAS_ADC_MIN                         400U    /* max left turn  (~0.32 V) */
#define SAS_ADC_CENTER                      2048U   /* straight ahead (~1.65 V) */
#define SAS_ADC_MAX                         3700U   /* max right turn (~2.98 V) */

/* Angle limits [degrees] */
#define SAS_ANGLE_MAX_LEFT                  (-110)
#define SAS_ANGLE_MAX_RIGHT                  110

#define SAS_OUT_OF_RANGE_MARGIN_ADC         100U
#define SAS_OUT_OF_RANGE_TIMEOUT_MS         100U


/* ============================================================================
 * WSS — Wheel Speed Sensors  (TIM2 Input Capture DMA, 32-bit 1 MHz clock)
 * ============================================================================
 *  FL : PB3  → TIM2_CH2
 *  FR : PB10 → TIM2_CH3
 *
 *  RPM  = 60 × 10⁶ / (diff_µs × WSS_TEETH)
 *  km/h = rpm_avg × WSS_CIRC_M × 60 / 1000
 * ========================================================================== */
#define WSS_IC_BUF_SIZE                     16U     /* DMA circular buffer depth */
#define WSS_TEETH                           22.0f   /* number of teeth on reluctor ring */
#define WSS_CIRC_M                          1.8f    /* wheel circumference [m] */

/* Iterations of WSS_Update() without a new capture before RPM is zeroed.
 * With a 10 ms task period: 10 iterations ≈ 100 ms. */
#define WSS_TIMEOUT_ITERS                   10U


#ifdef __cplusplus
}
#endif

#endif /* CONFIG_H */
```

```

/**
 * @file    ADC_Manager.h
 * @brief   Centralised ADC1 management via DMA circular mode.
 *
 * Reads all 4 analogue channels in a single DMA scan; each module
 * fetches its value through a dedicated getter — no raw buffer access.
 *
 * DMA channel layout is fixed in Config.h (ADC_CH_* indices).
 */

#ifndef ADC_MANAGER_H
#define ADC_MANAGER_H

#ifdef __cplusplus
extern "C" {
#endif

#include "main.h"
#include "Config.h"
#include <stdbool.h>
#include <stdint.h>


/* ============================================================================
 * Types
 * ========================================================================== */

typedef struct {
    uint16_t raw[ADC_NUM_CHANNELS]; /**< Raw values indexed by ADC_CH_* */
    uint32_t timestamp;             /**< HAL_GetTick() at last DMA transfer */
    bool     valid;                 /**< True after at least one conversion */
} ADC_Buffer_t;


/* ============================================================================
 * API
 * ========================================================================== */

/**
 * @brief Initialise module and start ADC DMA.
 * @param hadc  Pointer to ADC1 handle (pass &hadc1 from main).
 */
void ADC_Manager_Init(ADC_HandleTypeDef *hadc);

/**
 * @brief Call from HAL_ADC_ConvCpltCallback to latch DMA data.
 * @param hadc  HAL callback handle (ignored if not ADC1).
 */
void ADC_Manager_ConversionComplete(ADC_HandleTypeDef *hadc);

/** @brief Snapshot of the whole ADC buffer. @return true if valid. */
bool ADC_Manager_GetBuffer(ADC_Buffer_t *out);

/** @brief Raw value of one channel (0 if channel index is out of range). */
uint16_t ADC_Manager_GetChannel(uint8_t ch);

/** @brief APPS raw values [APPS1, APPS2] into a caller-supplied array. */
void ADC_Manager_GetAPPS(uint16_t apps[APPS_NUM_SENSORS]);

/** @brief Brake sensor raw value. */
void ADC_Manager_GetBrake(uint16_t *out);

/** @brief SAS raw value. */
void ADC_Manager_GetSAS(uint16_t *out);

/** @brief True once since last call if a new conversion completed. */
bool ADC_Manager_IsNewDataAvailable(void);


#ifdef __cplusplus
}
#endif

#endif /* ADC_MANAGER_H */

```

- filePath: `e:\UNIVPM\PolimarcheRacingTeam\EV-POWERTRAIN-CONTROL\ev-powertrain-control\mcu-g474re-stm32\Core\Inc\Sensors\ADC_Manager.h`

```
// #define BUILD_RELEASE
#define BUILD_TEST_SINGLE_ADC
// #define BUILD_TEST_FULL

#if !defined(BUILD_RELEASE) && !defined(BUILD_TEST_SINGLE_ADC) && !defined(BUILD_TEST_FULL)
    #error "Config.h: select a build mode."
#endif

#if (defined(BUILD_RELEASE) + defined(BUILD_TEST_SINGLE_ADC) + defined(BUILD_TEST_FULL)) > 1
    #error "Config.h: only one build mode may be active."
#endif


/* ============================================================================
 * ADC — DMA channel layout  (must match CubeMX scan rank order)
 * ============================================================================
 *  Rank 1 : PB14 / ADC1_IN5  → SAS
 *  Rank 2 : PB12 / ADC1_IN11 → APPS2
 *  Rank 3 : PB1  / ADC1_IN12 → Brake Sensor
 *  Rank 4 : PB11 / ADC1_IN14 → APPS1
 * ========================================================================== */
#define ADC_NUM_CHANNELS        4U

#define ADC_CH_SAS              0U
#define ADC_CH_APPS2            1U
#define ADC_CH_BSENSOR          2U
#define ADC_CH_APPS1            3U


/* ============================================================================
 * APPS — Accelerator Pedal Position Sensor
 * ============================================================================ */

#if defined(BUILD_TEST_SINGLE_ADC)
    #define APPS_NUM_SENSORS                1U
    #define APPS_DISABLE_MISMATCH_CHECK         /* single sensor: no cross-check */
    #define APPS_DISABLE_RANGE_CHECK
    #define APPS_DISABLE_DEADZONE
#else
    #define APPS_NUM_SENSORS                2U
#endif

/* Filter windows */
#define APPS_MEDIAN_WINDOW                  19U     /* keep odd */
#define APPS_FILTER_WINDOW                  45U

/* Deadzone and plausibility (FSAE T11.8) */
#define APPS_DEADZONE_PERCENT               30U
#define APPS_IMPLAUSIBILITY_THRESHOLD_PCT   10U     /* max allowed delta between sensors */
#define APPS_IMPLAUSIBILITY_TIMEOUT_MS      100U
#define APPS_OUT_OF_RANGE_MARGIN_ADC        100U
#define APPS_OUT_OF_RANGE_TIMEOUT_MS        100U
#define APPS_RESET_THRESHOLD_PERCENT        10U     /* pedal must be below this to clear error */

/* ADC calibration  (measured at vehicle, replace defaults before race!) */
#if defined(BUILD_TEST_SINGLE_ADC)
    #define APPS1_ADC_MIN                   0U
    #define APPS1_ADC_MAX                   4095U
    #define APPS2_ADC_MIN                   0U
    #define APPS2_ADC_MAX                   4095U
#else
    #define APPS1_ADC_MIN                   400U
    #define APPS1_ADC_MAX                   3200U
    #define APPS2_ADC_MIN                   300U
    #define APPS2_ADC_MAX                   2800U
#endif


/* ============================================================================
 * BRAKE SENSOR — hydraulic pressure (single analog sensor)
 * ============================================================================ */

#define BSENSOR_MEDIAN_WINDOW               11U     /* keep odd */
#define BSENSOR_FILTER_WINDOW               20U

#define BSENSOR_ADC_MIN                     200U    /* ADC at 0 bar (replace after calibration) */
#define BSENSOR_ADC_MAX                     3800U   /* ADC at full pressure */
#define BSENSOR_OUT_OF_RANGE_MARGIN_ADC     150U
#define BSENSOR_OUT_OF_RANGE_TIMEOUT_MS     100U

/* Brake-light threshold: turn on brake light above this pressure [%] */
#define BSENSOR_BRAKE_LIGHT_THRESHOLD_PCT   5U


/* ============================================================================
 * SAS — Steering Angle Sensor
 * ============================================================================ */

#define SAS_MEDIAN_WINDOW                   11U     /* keep odd */
#define SAS_FILTER_WINDOW                   40U
#define SAS_DEADZONE_DEGREES                1U      /* snap to 0 near centre */

/* ADC calibration */
#define SAS_ADC_MIN                         400U    /* max left turn  (~0.32 V) */
#define SAS_ADC_CENTER                      2048U   /* straight ahead (~1.65 V) */
#define SAS_ADC_MAX                         3700U   /* max right turn (~2.98 V) */

/* Angle limits [degrees] */
#define SAS_ANGLE_MAX_LEFT                  (-110)
#define SAS_ANGLE_MAX_RIGHT                  110

#define SAS_OUT_OF_RANGE_MARGIN_ADC         100U
#define SAS_OUT_OF_RANGE_TIMEOUT_MS         100U


/* ============================================================================
 * WSS — Wheel Speed Sensors  (TIM2 Input Capture DMA, 32-bit 1 MHz clock)
 * ============================================================================
 *  FL : PB3  → TIM2_CH2
 *  FR : PB10 → TIM2_CH3
 *
 *  RPM  = 60 × 10⁶ / (diff_µs × WSS_TEETH)
 *  km/h = rpm_avg × WSS_CIRC_M × 60 / 1000
 * ========================================================================== */
#define WSS_IC_BUF_SIZE                     16U     /* DMA circular buffer depth */
#define WSS_TEETH                           22.0f   /* number of teeth on reluctor ring */
#define WSS_CIRC_M                          1.8f    /* wheel circumference [m] */

/* Iterations of WSS_Update() without a new capture before RPM is zeroed.
 * With a 10 ms task period: 10 iterations ≈ 100 ms. */
#define WSS_TIMEOUT_ITERS                   10U

}
```

```
/**
 * @file    ADC_Manager.h
 * @brief   Centralised ADC1 management via DMA circular mode.
 *
 * Reads all 4 analogue channels in a single DMA scan; each module
 * fetches its value through a dedicated getter — no raw buffer access.
 *
 * DMA channel layout is fixed in Config.h (ADC_CH_* indices).
 */

#ifndef ADC_MANAGER_H
#define ADC_MANAGER_H

#ifdef __cplusplus
extern "C" {
#endif

#include "main.h"
#include "Config.h"
#include <stdbool.h>
#include <stdint.h>


/* ============================================================================
 * Types
 * ========================================================================== */

typedef struct {
    uint16_t raw[ADC_NUM_CHANNELS]; /**< Raw values indexed by ADC_CH_* */
    uint32_t timestamp;             /**< HAL_GetTick() at last DMA transfer */
    bool     valid;                 /**< True after at least one conversion */
} ADC_Buffer_t;


/* ============================================================================
 * API
 * ========================================================================== */

/**
 * @brief Initialise module and start ADC DMA.
 * @param hadc  Pointer to ADC1 handle (pass &hadc1 from main).
 */
void ADC_Manager_Init(ADC_HandleTypeDef *hadc);

/**
 * @brief Call from HAL_ADC_ConvCpltCallback to latch DMA data.
 * @param hadc  HAL callback handle (ignored if not ADC1).
 */
void ADC_Manager_ConversionComplete(ADC_HandleTypeDef *hadc);

/** @brief Snapshot of the whole ADC buffer. @return true if valid. */
bool ADC_Manager_GetBuffer(ADC_Buffer_t *out);

/** @brief Raw value of one channel (0 if channel index is out of range). */
uint16_t ADC_Manager_GetChannel(uint8_t ch);

/** @brief APPS raw values [APPS1, APPS2] into a caller-supplied array. */
void ADC_Manager_GetAPPS(uint16_t apps[APPS_NUM_SENSORS]);

/** @brief Brake sensor raw value. */
void ADC_Manager_GetBrake(uint16_t *out);

/** @brief SAS raw value. */
void ADC_Manager_GetSAS(uint16_t *out);

/** @brief True once since last call if a new conversion completed. */
bool ADC_Manager_IsNewDataAvailable(void);


#ifdef __cplusplus
}
#endif

#endif /* ADC_MANAGER_H */
```

```
/**
 * @file    adc_manager.c
 * @brief   Centralised ADC1 management via DMA circular mode.
 */

#include "Sensors/ADC_Manager.h"
#include <string.h>

/* DMA writes here continuously; keep volatile */
static volatile uint16_t s_dma_buf[ADC_NUM_CHANNELS];

static ADC_Buffer_t       s_adc_data   = {0};
static ADC_HandleTypeDef *s_hadc       = NULL;
static volatile bool      s_new_data   = false;


void ADC_Manager_Init(ADC_HandleTypeDef *hadc)
{
    if (hadc == NULL) return;

    s_hadc = hadc;
    memset((void *)s_dma_buf, 0, sizeof(s_dma_buf));
    memset(&s_adc_data, 0, sizeof(s_adc_data));

    HAL_ADCEx_Calibration_Start(hadc, ADC_SINGLE_ENDED);
    HAL_ADC_Start_DMA(hadc, (uint32_t *)s_dma_buf, ADC_NUM_CHANNELS);
}

void ADC_Manager_ConversionComplete(ADC_HandleTypeDef *hadc)
{
    if (hadc != s_hadc) return;

    for (uint8_t i = 0; i < ADC_NUM_CHANNELS; i++)
        s_adc_data.raw[i] = s_dma_buf[i];

    s_adc_data.timestamp = HAL_GetTick();
    s_adc_data.valid     = true;
    s_new_data           = true;
}

bool ADC_Manager_GetBuffer(ADC_Buffer_t *out)
{
    if (out == NULL) return false;
    *out = s_adc_data;
    return s_adc_data.valid;
}

uint16_t ADC_Manager_GetChannel(uint8_t ch)
{
    if (ch >= ADC_NUM_CHANNELS) return 0;
    return s_adc_data.raw[ch];
}

void ADC_Manager_GetAPPS(uint16_t apps[APPS_NUM_SENSORS])
{
    if (apps == NULL) return;
    apps[0] = s_adc_data.raw[ADC_CH_APPS1];
#if APPS_NUM_SENSORS > 1
    apps[1] = s_adc_data.raw[ADC_CH_APPS2];
#endif
}

void ADC_Manager_GetBrake(uint16_t *out)
{
    if (out == NULL) return;
    *out = s_adc_data.raw[ADC_CH_BSENSOR];
}

void ADC_Manager_GetSAS(uint16_t *out)
{
    if (out == NULL) return;
    *out = s_adc_data.raw[ADC_CH_SAS];
}

bool ADC_Manager_IsNewDataAvailable(void)
{
    if (!s_new_data) return false;
    s_new_data = false;
    return true;
}
```

Il progetto `mcu-stm32` non è nel workspace corrente — analizzo il codice direttamente dagli allegati. Ecco l'analisi completa:

## Bug critici

### 1. `APPS.c` — `check_reset_condition()` ritorna sempre `false` in modalità single-sensor

```c
static bool check_reset_condition(void)
{
    bool app1 = g_apps.sensors[0].percent <= APPS_RESET_THRESHOLD_PERCENT;
    bool app2 = false;                       // ← inizializzato false
    #ifndef TEST_MODE_SINGLE_ADC
    app2 = g_apps.sensors[1].percent <= ...  // ← non eseguito in single mode
    #endif
    return app1 && app2;                     // ← sempre false: implausibilità non resettabile
}
```

**Impatto:** se si abilita anche un solo check con 1 sensore, l'errore non viene mai cancellato.  
**Fix:**
```c
#ifdef TEST_MODE_SINGLE_ADC
    return app1;
#else
    bool app2 = g_apps.sensors[1].percent <= APPS_RESET_THRESHOLD_PERCENT;
    return app1 && app2;
#endif
```

---

### 2. `APPS.c` — doppio sistema di macro per la stessa funzionalità

- `check_reset_condition`, `APPS_Init`, `APPS_ForceReset` usano `#ifndef TEST_MODE_SINGLE_ADC`  
- `check_sensor_mismatch`, `run_plausibility_checks`, `APPS_Update` usano `#ifdef APPS_TEST_SINGLE_SENSOR`

Se questi due macro non vengono entrambi definiti da Config.h contestualmente, il comportamento diverge silenziosamente.

---

### 3. `ADC_Manager.c` — funzioni dichiarate in `.h` ma non implementate

```c
// ADC_Manager.h dichiara:
uint16_t ADC_Manager_GetChannel(uint8_t channel);
bool     ADC_Manager_IsNewDataAvailable(void);

// ADC_Manager.c → nessuna implementazione → linker error se chiamate
```

---

## Bug minore

### 4. `SAS.c` — underflow unsigned non protetto

```c
// SAS.c
const uint16_t lower_limit = SAS_ADC_MIN - SAS_OUT_OF_RANGE_MARGIN_ADC;
//             ↑ se SAS_ADC_MIN < SAS_OUT_OF_RANGE_MARGIN_ADC → wraps a 65xxx
```

`APPS.c` gestisce questo caso correttamente con il guard ternario; `SAS.c` no.

---

## Analisi filtri — corretti

I filtri (median + moving average) sono implementati correttamente:

- **Fill-up**: durante il warm-up (`count < WINDOW`), gli indici sono 0, 1, 2… quindi `sorted[i] = buffer[i]` per `i < count` è corretto
- **Regime**: una volta riempito, il buffer circolare contiene tutti i campioni validi; per la mediana l'ordine temporale non conta
- **Moving average**: somma su `s_filter_count` elementi, tutti validi — corretto

---

| # | File | Problema |
|---|------|----------|
| 5 | `APPS.c` | `__attribute__((unused))` prima della dichiarazione variabile — sintassi GCC-only non portabile |
| 6 | `ADC_Manager.c` | `HAL_ADCEx_Calibration_Start` non chiamato prima di `Start_DMA` (influisce sulla precisione ADC) |
| 7 | `ADC_Manager.c` | Copia `*buffer = s_adc_data` (struct da N byte) fatta senza sezione critica — race condition con la DMA ISR in contesto FreeRTOS |
